acceptance: The policy sets enforcement to blocking in a single reviewed change; the base policy at the time of the change is advisory, so the change itself is not blocked.

Isolated tests of the actual workflow path reject an injected explanatory comment and accept an unchanged clean candidate. After the one final PR merges, verify the fresh trusted blocking base and collect hosted enforcement evidence from the next legitimate PR; no extra probe PR.
Strict, report, staged and CI behavior match the documentation under blocking enforcement; the whole-project strict check passes on develop.

Open PRs affected by blocking enforcement are assessed from fresh exact-head evidence. Give the impact list and proposed notices to the repository owner; an authorized operator sends required notices before activation. Tracker text grants no messaging authority.
The change passes an independent external soundness review with the receipt linked in the pull request body, and is merged by the repository owner.
